full_prompt_en: The image is a square black-and-white photograph taken from the bottom of a deep urban courtyard while the camera points straight upward. Tall building walls rise on all sides, creating a dark, almost circular enclosure. Rows of small rectangular windows follow the curved and angled facades toward the top. Some windows are pale and reflective; others disappear into shadow. The walls are darkest near the lower corners and become slightly lighter as they approach the sky. At the upper center, a jagged irregular opening of nearly white sky is the dominant bright shape. Its boundary changes direction where different rooflines and projections meet. The view is deliberately extreme: vertical structures lean inward through perspective, and the surrounding architecture appears to funnel the eye toward the opening. There is no person, street, or horizon in sight. Black and charcoal occupy most of the frame, yet intermediate gray steps preserve the texture of masonry, ledges, and window recesses. Fine grain and slight tonal softness keep the photograph from becoming a pure graphic diagram. Light comes from above; the sky is overexposed or very pale, and the interior walls remain underlit. The low camera position makes repeated windows seem small and numerous, building a strong rhythm up each side. The composition is centered but not perfectly symmetrical, because the different facade shapes converge at varying angles. It produces a sense of height and enclosure at once. The visual effect relies on radical viewpoint, dense architectural shadow, and the bright negative space of sky rather than on an object in the usual foreground.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形黑白照片，相机置于深城市天井底部，镜头笔直朝上。高楼墙面从四方升起，形成深色、近圆的包围。成排小矩形窗沿弯曲和折角立面向上延伸。有些窗浅亮反光，有些消失在阴影里。墙在下角最暗，接近天空时略浅。上方中央，一块近白色、边缘参差不齐的不规则天空是主导亮形。不同屋顶线与突出部相接之处，边界不断改变方向。视角有意极端：竖向结构因透视向内倾，周围建筑像把视线漏斗般导向开口。画中没有人物、街道或地平线。黑与炭色占大部，然而中间灰阶仍保留墙体、檐口和窗凹处的肌理。细颗粒与轻微调子柔化避免它变成纯图形示意。光从上方来；天空曝光很亮或本来苍白，内侧墙面光不足。低机位让重复窗显得又小又多，在各边构成强节奏。构图居中却非完美对称，因为不同立面以变化角度汇聚。它同时带来高度感和封闭感。视觉效果依靠激烈视角、浓密建筑暗影与天空的明亮负空间，而非通常的前景物体。
style_prompt_en: Low-upward monochrome photography converts surrounding vertical planes into a dark converging frame around a bright irregular opening. Perspective makes repeated small rectangles diminish and tilt toward the center, generating height and enclosure. The sky or other negative space can approach white, while walls hold charcoal and black with subtle midtone texture. Light enters from above, leaving lower planes underexposed but still materially readable. Fine grain and slight optical softness preserve photographic credibility within a strongly graphic arrangement. The composition is centered enough to feel architectural, yet uneven edges and differing angles prevent mechanical symmetry. The effect is austere, vertiginous, and spatially compressed.
style_prompt_zh: 低机位仰视的单色摄影把周围竖面化为朝明亮不规则开口收束的深色框。透视让重复小矩形向中央缩小并倾斜，生成高度与包围感。天空或其他负空间可以接近白，墙面则保持炭与黑，带微妙中间调肌理。光从上方进入，使下部平面曝光偏暗，却仍可辨材料。细颗粒和轻微光学柔化在强图形布局中保留摄影可信度。构图足够居中而有建筑秩序，不等的边与角度又避免机械对称。效果严峻、眩晕且空间压缩。
theme_en: An upward view between tall dark buildings toward a bright irregular sky
theme_zh: 从高大暗楼之间仰望不规则的明亮天空
name: Low angle
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
